messages:
Noah Li: Noticed inconsistent tooltip numbers on small charts — sometimes compact (1.2K), sometimes full (1,234). Confusing.
Evelyn Brooks: Yeah reusing axis formatter for tooltip. We should decouple.
Jonas Weber: Quick proposal: tooltip primary = exact integer with separators; secondary muted line = compact form + unit. Keeps clarity and low noise.
a11y-bot: Accessibility note: aria-label must read the full number in words for screen readers.
Noah Li: For sparklines where space is tight, show compact only but add a small "..." button to expand full value; keyboard-focusable.
Evelyn Brooks: Also suggest a per-chart "Clamp extremes" switch in top-right. When enabled show a legend bubble: "Clamped" with a tooltip: "Extreme values hidden to emphasize typical trends. Hover for raw values."
Jonas Weber: Implementation: emit an annotation when clipping occurs so downstream jobs can detect it. Also tokenized gridline color needs bump for contrast.
a11y-bot: Suggested copy: "Chart trimmed extreme values to highlight trends. Full numbers available on hover or in the raw table."
Noah Li: I'll sketch RFC and add acceptance criteria (1) hover shows full integer + muted compact by default, (2) sparklines compact+expandable, (3) clamp toggle + legend bubble + annotation, (4) aria-label reads full number words, (5) gridline contrast tokens. ETA: tomorrow afternoon.
Evelyn Brooks: I'll mock the small-expand interaction and test keyboard flow.
Jonas Weber: I'll add token PR and make tooltip formatter configurable.
Noah Li: Thanks—ping if you want copy adjusted. :thumbsup:
